operating_notes.text: Received a show cause notice from the Excise & Taxation Department, Haryana, for a GST liability mismatch of ₹19,78,228 (inclusive of interest) between GSTR-3B and GSTR-2A.

Received Show Cause Notice from Office of Central GST Commissionerate, Dehradun for tax liability of ₹50,10,05,632 and penalty of ₹50,10,05,632 plus applicable interest for FYs 2018-19 to 2020-21 due to difference between e-way bill portal
FY25 total operating income was ₹453.98 Cr with PBILDT margin of 9.78% and a net loss of ₹48.04 Cr.
Working capital utilisation was ~78% in the 12 months to May 2025, with cash and equivalents of ~₹0.22 Cr as on March 31, 2025.
Hero MotoCorp Limited contributes around 40% of SAL's revenue and SAL supplies 65-70% of HML's gears and shafts requirement.
The ₹25 Cr NCDs carry a 12.00% p.a. coupon and are secured by a first-ranking exclusive charge over specified receivables.
Tenure, moratorium, allotment and maturity dates of the NCDs are to be decided by the Board in due course.
Board approved NCD issuance of up to ₹225 Cr by private placement to proposed persons; the NCDs will not be listed.
Post-conversion shareholding: promoters 52.80%, institutional investors 29.46%, non-institutions 17.74%.
₹32 Cr NCDs allotted to Alpha Alternatives Structured Credit Opportunities Fund at 10% p.a., tenure up to 36 months with 18-month moratorium.
Corrigendum states ₹115 Cr of the ₹120 Cr OCD proceeds will repay NCDs issued to the Proposed Allottee, with ₹5 Cr for long-term working capital.
Q3FY26 revenue was ₹96.18 Cr, down 15% YoY from ₹112.74 Cr, with nine-month revenue at ₹300.15 Cr versus ₹346.14 Cr in 9MFY25.
Net worth turned negative at ₹22.83 Cr as at 31 December 2025, from positive ₹31.48 Cr in September 2025, due to nine-month losses of ₹54.61 Cr.
The company recognised a ₹1.12 Cr exceptional charge in Q3FY26 for the statutory impact of new labour codes notified on 21 November 2025.
The ₹75 Cr OCD issue to Alpha Alternatives carries a 10.00% p.a. coupon, a 12-month lock-in and up to 18-month tenure from the deemed allotment date of 10 February 2026.
The ₹45 Cr OCD issue to Alpha Alternatives carries a 10.00% p.a. coupon, a 12-month lock-in and up to 18-month tenure from the deemed allotment date of 12 February 2026.
FY26 EBITDA was ₹31.80 Cr on revenue of ₹409.58 Cr, a 7.76% margin.
Related-party borrowings from Dayanand Munjal Investment Pvt Ltd stood at ₹93.54 Cr with interest payable of ₹29.53 Cr at 31 March 2026.
Sales to related party Munjal Showa Limited were ₹8.73 Cr in FY26, down from ₹10.72 Cr in FY25.
Rights issue of up to ₹120 Cr approved; issue price, entitlement ratio and record date to be decided by the Board later.
FY26 cash losses of ₹35.02 Cr per CARO, versus ₹5.68 Cr in FY25.
Contingent liabilities of ₹11.15 Cr at Mar-2026, of which ₹10.77 Cr is sales tax/VAT/GST demands.
Debt-equity ratio reported at (9.80) versus 10.59 in the previous year.
The rights issue price is ₹12 per share, six times the ₹2 face value, with the full amount payable on application.
The issue is for up to 10,00,00,000 shares, which at ₹12 each aggregates up to ₹120 Cr.

timeline.summary: CARE Ratings reaffirmed Shivam Autotech's Long Term Facilities at CARE BB-; Stable and Short Term Facilities at CARE A4 on January 3, 2025, citing fund infusion and promoter support but highlighting weak financials and high gearing
Shivam Autotech approved raising up to ₹50 Cr via secured unlisted NCDs by private placement on January 18, 2025.
Shivam Autotech approved raising up to ₹50 Cr via secured unlisted NCDs by private placement on January 18, 2025.

On 22 January 2025 Shivam Autotech's board approved a QIP of up to ₹160 Cr and a rights issue of up to ₹125 Cr, plus an increase in authorised capital to ₹44 Cr, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.
Shivam Autotech announced a postal ballot seeking shareholder approval to increase authorised capital to ₹44 Cr and raise up to ₹160 Cr via QIP, with voting open from January 24 to February 22, 2025.
Q3FY25 results (standalone): revenue ₹112.74 Cr (-6.7% YoY), net loss ₹11.86 Cr (against a loss of ₹14.58 Cr a year earlier).
Shivam Autotech allotted ₹12 Cr of secured NCDs on private placement on 12 February 2025, following board approval on 18 January 2025.
India Credit Opportunities Fund II requested conversion of ₹25 Cr OCDs into 92,72,997 equity shares on 14 February 2025.
Shivam Autotech converted ₹25 Cr of OCDs into 92,72,997 equity shares for India Credit Opportunities Fund II on 20 February 2025.
2025-02-23: Postal ballot approved authorized capital increase and QIP
Shivam Autotech board approved ₹40 Cr term loan for debt refinancing and working capital on March 13, 2025
Shivam Autotech fined ₹59,000 by BSE on April 15, 2025, for non-compliance with Regulation 28 of SEBI LODR regarding in-principle approval before securities issuance.
Shivam Autotech received in-principle approval from NSE for listing 9,272,997 equity shares on May 9, 2025.
Shivam Autotech board approved audited FY25 results and re-appointed auditors on May 12, 2025.
Received BSE listing approval for 92,72,997 equity shares allotted via conversion of optionally convertible debentures on May 21, 2025.
India Credit Opportunities Fund II acquired a 7.05% stake in Shivam Autotech through conversion of 250 OCDs into equity shares on 27 May 2025.
Shivam Autotech received trading approval from BSE and NSE on 12 June 2025 for 92,72,997 equity shares allotted on conversion of optionally convertible debentures, listed from 13 June 2025.
Shivam Autotech disclosed a show cause notice from the Excise & Taxation Department, Haryana, alleging a GST liability mismatch of ₹19.78 lakh, which it will challenge.
Received a show cause notice from Central GST Commissionerate, Dehradun for GST liability of ₹50.10 Cr and equal penalty for FY19-FY21 due to e-way bill vs GSTR 3-B mismatch
Shivam Autotech allotted ₹20 Cr of secured unlisted NCDs via private placement on 3 July 2025.
CARE Ratings reaffirmed credit ratings for Shivam Autotech's bank facilities with Long Term at CARE BB-; Negative and Short Term at CARE A4, revising outlook from Stable to Negative
Shivam Autotech received a ₹1.34 Cr GST demand order from Karnataka government on July 31, 2025, which it plans to appeal
Shivam Autotech approved issuance of up to ₹25 Cr secured unlisted NCDs via private placement on 8 August 2025.
Shivam Autotech allotted 250 secured unlisted redeemable NCDs of ₹10,00,000 each, aggregating ₹25 Cr, at a 12% coupon on a private placement basis.
Shivam Autotech reported Q1FY26 standalone results with a widened loss of ₹17.66 Cr and a 5.86% EBITDA margin.
Shivam Autotech FY25 standalone revenue declined 3.3% YoY to ₹453.98 Cr with net loss of ₹48.04 Cr
Shivam Autotech Ltd’s 20th AGM held on **22 September 2025** via VC, chaired by **Yogesh Chander Munjal**, with **70 members** attending.
Shivam Autotech Ltd held its 20th AGM on September 22, 2025, via video conferencing with 99.999% approval for audited financial statements and 99.99% for Mrs. Charu Munjal’s re-appointment.

Shivam Autotech received a ₹2.64 Cr GST show cause notice from the C.G.S.T. Audit Commissionerate, Dehradun, for alleged excess ITC availment in FY2019-20, which the company contests as a reconciliation matter.
On 02 October 2025, Shivam Autotech disclosed receipt of a GST show cause notice for ₹1.72 Cr from Haryana Excise & Taxation Department for FY21-22, which it contests as a reconciliation matter.
Shivam Autotech's board approved raising up to ₹225 Cr through secured, redeemable non-convertible debentures by private placement, subject to shareholder and other approvals.
Shivam Autotech's board scheduled to meet on 12 Nov 2025 to consider raising funds via borrowings including NCDs on private placement or preferential allotment basis.
Shivam Autotech's board approved raising up to ₹245 Cr via unlisted, unrated NCDs by private placement to address liquidity needs.
Shivam Autotech's board approved raising up to ₹105 Cr via secured NCDs by private placement on 26 Nov 2025.

Shivam Autotech's board approved raising up to ₹120 Cr via issuance of unlisted, secured, redeemable, optionally convertible debentures to Alpha Alternative Fund, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.

Shivam Autotech sought shareholder approval via postal ballot for ₹120 Cr of OCDs to Alpha Alternative Structured Credit Opportunities Fund, convertible at ₹28.81 into 4.17 Cr shares, alongside a ₹600 Cr borrowing-limit increase.
Shivam Autotech allotted ₹200 Cr of secured NCDs to Alpha Alternatives Structured Credit Opportunities Fund on 5 December 2025 via private placement.
Shivam Autotech allotted ₹45 Cr of secured NCDs to Alpha Alternatives Structured Credit Opportunities Fund on 5 December 2025 via private placement.

Shivam Autotech allotted ₹32 Cr of secured, unlisted, unrated NCDs at 10% p.a. to Alpha Alternatives Structured Credit Opportunities Fund on 8 December 2025, its fifth Alpha Alternatives debt raise since late November.

Shivam Autotech issued a corrigendum on 16 December 2025 to its 1 December 2025 postal ballot notice, detailing the ₹120 Cr OCD preferential issue and ₹115 Cr repayment of NCDs to the Proposed Allottee.
Shivam Autotech received closure order dropping GST proceedings with NIL demand on December 22, 2025

Shivam Autotech shareholders approved all five postal ballot resolutions on 1 January 2026, including the ₹120 Cr OCD preferential issue to Alpha Alternatives and special rights, with 99.94% votes in favour but 47.7% of participating public non-institutional shareholders voting against.
Shivam Autotech received in-principle approval from BSE and NSE for preferential issue of up to 12,000 OCDs aggregating to ₹120 Cr on 2 February 2026.
Shivam Autotech reported Q3FY26 net loss of ₹24.53 Cr on revenue of ₹96.18 Cr, with nine-month loss at ₹54.61 Cr and net worth turning negative at ₹22.83 Cr as at 31 December 2025.

Shivam Autotech allotted ₹75 Cr of 10% secured optionally convertible debentures to Alpha Alternatives Structured Credit Opportunities Fund on 11 February 2026, with a 12-month lock-in and up to 18-month tenure.

Shivam Autotech allotted ₹45 Cr of 10% secured optionally convertible debentures to Alpha Alternatives Structured Credit Opportunities Fund on 12 February 2026, its fourth tranche from that fund since November 2025.
On 31 March 2026, Shivam Autotech received a GST order from Dehradun commissionerate proposing tax demand of ₹2.46 Cr and penalty of ₹2.11 Cr for disallowance of Input Tax Credit.
Shivam Autotech reported FY26 revenue of ₹409.58 Cr and a net loss of ₹81.33 Cr, with net worth turning negative at ₹40.68 Cr and the auditor flagging going-concern dependence on refinancing.

On 1 July 2026, Shivam Autotech's board approved a rights issue of up to ₹120 Cr (₹12,000 lakh) and the draft letter of offer for exchange in-principle approval, with price, ratio and record date to be decided later; it also appointed CS Mehvish as Company Secretary.
Shivam Autotech reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹109.58 Cr (up 20.8% YoY) and net loss of ₹20.99 Cr, with EBITDA at ₹7.92 Cr.

Shivam Autotech's FY26 annual report carries an unmodified audit opinion with a going-concern emphasis (net loss ₹82.05 Cr, current liabilities exceeding current assets by ₹50.60 Cr) and a qualified internal-controls opinion on inventory and vendor reconciliation, with CARO cash losses of ₹35.02 Cr.

Shivam Autotech Ltd held its 21st AGM on September 25, 2026, via video conferencing with 107 members attending and directors including Yogesh Chander Munjal, Neeraj Munjal, Charu Munjal, Sunil Vakil, Dr. Neetika Batra, Devendra Kumar Goyal, and Ms. Mehvish participating.
Shivam Autotech Ltd’s 21st AGM held on September 25, 2026, via VC/OAVM, adopted audited financials for FY2025-26 with 99.9% shareholder approval.
Shivam Autotech fixed October 15, 2026 as the record date for its ₹120 Cr rights issue of up to 10,00,00,000 shares at ₹12 each (19:25).
Shivam Autotech intimated ISIN INE637H20024 for the rights entitlements of its ₹120 Cr rights issue, to be credited to eligible shareholders before the issue opens.
Shivam Autotech filed its Letter of Offer for a ₹120 Cr rights issue of up to 10,00,00,000 shares at ₹12 each (19:25 ratio), record date October 15, 2026, issue open October 22 to November 19, 2026.
Shivam Autotech filed its Letter of Offer for a ₹120 Cr rights issue of up to 10,00,00,000 shares at ₹12 each (19:25 ratio), record date October 15, 2026, issue open October 22 to November 19, 2026.
